title: Session start failed: clock not synchronized or other error
symptom: User started getting an error 'Session start failed: clock not synchronized or other error' out of the blue. Tried restarting the sensor, hard resetting the transmitter, and using a brand new sensor, but the error persisted.
fix: The user ended up getting a replacement transmitter as nothing else seemed to work.
evidence_quote: Ended up getting a replacement transmitter as nothing else seemed to work.
